intro: Woodgrove Edge is an HDB project in Woodlands. A third-party completion estimate is on file, but this entry is not officially confirmed. HDB has not verified a project-wide key date, and tracker sources have disagreed on the month, so unit counts and any estimated month are left out of the facts below. The word “Edge” is not treated as a confirmed typologies or outlook feature. If you have a key-appointment letter, that is the date that matters. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Woodgrove Edge renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Woodgrove Edge interior
sections.text:
Owners in this Woodgrove cluster who are close to keys usually want the flat to work from week one: a fitted kitchen, full-height wardrobes, an entry cabinet, and a living-room joinery wall, rather than a temporary set of loose furniture. Maison designs that work as built-in carpentry, photographed professionally, including closer material shots when you are choosing a finish. We do not use IKEA-style furniture as the backbone of the home. No official floor plan is on file, and we will not invent a typical Woodgrove Edge layout or copy one from Ascent or South Plains.

UrbanVille @ Woodlands, Woodgrove Ascent, Woodlands South Plains and Woodgrove Acres are the other Woodlands pages in this batch; Acres is a June 2026 BTO launch and is years away from keys. Norwood Grand and Wynwood Grand are nearby links only. We will not invent walking times to Woodgrove or to any MRT station. Check your block, facing and the HDB renovation rules before you plan blinds, a window bench or any hacking, and do not start work from a tracker month.

After keys, inspect defects, measure, and apply for the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at six to ten weeks on site after approvals, as an editorial planning figure only. WhatsApp Maison with your approved plan and any key letter you have. We are not affiliated with HDB.
